messages:
Evan (Partnerships): Quick thread: Nimble Hardware x Redwood joint webinar at CloudInterop on Tue. Need final deck, demo fallback, customs for kits, and partner logo lock.
Mira (Cloud Partnerships): Can partners sign off on co-branded slide by Mon noon? Also need marketplace tile copy (max 50 words).
Hiro (Nimble Hardware): We'll sign off. Sending hi-res logo + legal blurb. Also confirm we can include a hardware coupon card in kits.
Priya (Marketing): Coupon OK. Need headshots + 1-line bios by Mon EOD. I'll produce a QR landing page for post-demo NPS.
Sam (Events): Format: 20m joint talk + 30m lab pods. Volunteers for pods: Evan, Mira, 2 from Nimble. On-site pickup 7:30am.
Tanya (Ops): Kit plan: 120 demo kits (carry-on), 30 partner-only boxes. Contents: branded cable, quickstart card with coupon, sticker, feedback QR. Customs note: any non-tech items flagged?
Joel (Logistics): If shipped internationally, need commercial invoice. If partner boxes originate from Nimble, provide HS codes by Tue. Placeholder label: DHL-TEMP-888. PO by Mon 9am.
Evan (Partnerships): Demo fallback: primary on Nimble device + Redwood Dedicated; fallback -> Redwood hosted + recorded clip. Runbook command for fallback:
```
# switch to recorded demo
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/switch -d '{"demo":"recorded","id":"cloudinterop-2"}'
```
Sam (Events): Run-through Mon 10am PT. Please RSVP. Calendar invite sent.
calendar-bot: Invite created -> 'Nimble + Redwood CloudInterop Runthrough' Mon 10:00am PT.
Mira (Cloud Partnerships): Action items recap: 1) Hiro -> logo + HS codes (Tue), 2) Priya -> QR + card design (Mon EOD), 3) Joel -> PO + labels (Mon AM), 4) Tanya -> manifest + customs notes (Mon noon).
Evan (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll chase logos and confirm volunteer roster. :rocket:
